newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to auction treasury bills Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to auction treasury bills Jan 14.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry said Thursday it will auction 250 million pesos in 91-day treasury bills (Letes) and 250 million pesos in 182-day Letes on Jan 14, at its monthly bill auction.
Offers are due by 1400 local/1700 GMT on Jan 14. The sale takes place through Dutch style auction with settlement due on Jan 17.
At its last auction on December 17, Argentina placed $250 million 91-day bills at a yield of 6.38 percent.
